description: This file contains test scripts for verifying the behavior of Git hooks, specifically a setup procedure for a 'proc-receive' hook and tests for pushing to a repository with expected output and reference states.

methods.name: test_hook

methods.description: Executes the 'proc-receive' command of 'test-tool' with verbose output and specific ref parameters.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves expectations for comparison in tests.

methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
